sentences.text: 2. Admit.
Learned AGP Ms.Hetal Patel waives service of notice of admission on behalf of the respondent-State.

3. By this appeal, the appellant has challenged the Judgment and Award dated 10.08.2018 passed by Heirs Of Khimjibhai Parbatbhai Moliya vs Executive Engineer on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125597549/

With consent of the learned advocates of both the sides the First Appeal is taken up for final disposal.
5. The land of the appellant-claimant was situated at Village Pasaya, Taluka and District Jamnagar was acquired for the purpose of Ruparel Irrigation Scheme.
6. A notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act") was published on 20.05.2003.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer by award dated 10.11.2004 in Land Acquisition Case No.11 of 2002 awarded Rs.3.75/- per square meter.
7. Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the award passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer the appellant-claimant preferred reference under Section 18 of the Act.

8. The Reference Court passed the impugned Judgment and Award dated 10.08.2018 rejecting the Reference case on the ground that the appellant or his advocate did not remain present inspite of giving sufficient opportunity by the Court for NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2740/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined more than eight months after framing of issues.
Therefore the right of the appellant-claimant to proceed further with the matter was closed by the Court on 05.04.2018 but no care was taken to remain present before the Reference Court.

Similarly, the respondent also did not bother to remain present before the Court and thereafter the Reference Court had no option but to proceed further to pass the impugned Judgment and Award rejecting the Reference Application under Section 26 of the Act.

9. In similar facts, the Coordinate Bench in the First Appeal No.4435 of 2022 following the orders passed in First Appeal No.4699 of 2019 dated 03.10.2019 and First Appeal No.862 of 2022 and allied matters dated 29.06.2022 remanded the matter back to the Reference Court.

10. Considering the aforesaid decisions of the Coordinate Bench it appears that a view has been taken that the Competent Court after taking into consideration the material which may be placed on record by the claimant or the respondent authorities, to decide whether the land owner was entitled to adequate compensation and as such the case was remanded back on a condition that the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2740/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined claimants would not be entitled to claim interest from the date of the impugned Judgment till the date of passing the order by this Court.
11.

Considering the view taken by the Coordinate Bench in the similar facts in other First Appeals,
the impugned Judgment and Award deserves to be interfered with as the Reference Court could not have rejected the Reference Case merely on the ground that no evidence is led by the claimant-appellant.

The Reference Court ought to have taken an independent decision relying upon Heirs Of Khimjibhai Parbatbhai Moliya vs Executive Engineer on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125597549/
2 the necessary documents including the award in question as well as other comparable sale instances of the surrounding land, earlier award etc. passed with regard to the land in the near vicinity.

12. Therefore in order to give a fair opportunity to the appellant before the Reference Court, the impugned Judgment and Award dated 10.08.2018 passed by the learned 3rd Additional Senior Civil Judge, Jamnagar in Land Acquisition Reference Case No.123 of 2004 is hereby quashed and set aside so as to give an opportunity to the appellant-claimant to lead any evidence, if required, but the appellant-claimant would not be NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2740/2023 ORDER DATED:
18/07/2023 undefined entitled to any interest for the period from the date of impugned Judgment and Award of the Reference Court till today i.e. from 10.08.2018 to 18.07.2023 on the enhanced amount of compensation if any.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Reference Case No.123 of 2004
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is further directed that the Reference Court shall hear and decide the Land Acquisition Reference Case No.123 of 2004 after giving an opportunity to the appellant- claimant to lead oral and documentary evidence.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Reference Case No.123 of 2004
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The appellant-claimant is also directed to cooperate with the Reference Court for expeditious hearing of the Land Reference Case.
Such exercise shall be completed within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order.
13. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this appeal is partly allowed.
No order as to costs.

(BHARGAV D. KARIA, J) URIL RANA Heirs Of Khimjibhai Parbatbhai Moliya vs Executive Engineer on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125597549/
